clips.title: The story
paras: Razor Hill links the Valley of Trials, the Barrens, and Orgrimmar at a crossroads in central Durotar. Its fortified barracks train young orc and troll warriors for life in the wilderness.

Razor Hill joins northern Durotar to the southern coast and the Barrens across the Southfury River. Stone-and-timber barracks and orcish burrows fill the settlement, founded early in Durotar's settlement. After the Third War, human forces from Kul Tiras lured the Horde here with a false offer of an emissary summit. Rexxar went in Thrall's stead and stopped their ambush. Razor Hill now stands fortified against further attacks from the coast.

Veteran officers such as Gar'Thok direct Razor Hill's defenses against threats nearby. Human marines still hold Tiragarde Keep on the eastern shore, while quilboar and harpy tribes harass supply lines. Investigators such as Orgnil Soulscar track the Burning Blade cult, whose rituals and corrupted agents lurk in the nearby crags, and work to stamp them out.
